findings.label: Unmarked upload disclosure
findings.detail: UploadPanel on /admin/media and the gallery editor's 'Upload new pictures' use <summary className="flex ...">, which removes the disclosure marker; the closed panel looks like an empty card (seen in admin-media-library-1280.png, admin-gallery-editor-1280.png). Add a chevron/'Show' affordance or open it by default.

findings.label: Blob ref not bound to the configured store
findings.detail: blobKeyOf/isBlobUrl accept any <store>.public.blob.vercel-storage.com host. Bind the host to the token's store in prepareUpload so foreign URLs get a clear validation error.

findings.label: Two sources of truth for gallery order
findings.detail: The media editor's free 'Order in gallery' sortOrder coexists with the gallery editor's 0..n-1 renumbering; manual values can tie or jump. Hide it or make it read-only for gallery items.

findings.label: Transitive audit findings from @vercel/blob 2.8.2
findings.detail: 4 high findings via @vercel/oidc -> @vercel/cli-config -> nested zod <4.6.6, recorded in verification.md; re-check in Phase 9 and take a pinned upstream fix when available.
